_comment: Per-part module metadata used by scripts/generate-feature-registry.mjs. AIGW = AI gateway (packages/ai-orchestration, not yet built).

statusDefinitions.Designed: Documented design exists (docs/), no working code.
statusDefinitions.Implementing: Some working code exists (e.g. backend and tests) but not every layer (API, persistence, UI) is done.
statusDefinitions.Implemented: Business logic, persistence, API and UI all functional.
statusDefinitions.Tested: Implemented and covered by automated tests that pass.
statusDefinitions.Integration pending: Built, awaiting an external provider integration.
statusDefinitions.External approval required: Needs credentials, regulatory or commercial approval outside the codebase.
statusDefinitions.Production ready: Acceptance criteria met and all required tests pass.
